sections.title: Colours
sections.description: Two colours build the S1S2 histogram two-colour PDA fits; three build the per-burst photon table three-colour PDA fits. The micro-time ranges are photon-selection windows for two colours and the blue/green excitation periods for three.

sections.label: Colours
sections.description: Defaults to the number of configured detection-channel groups, so a three-colour setup selects c3PDA on its own.

sections.title: Segmentation
sections.description: How the photon stream is cut into observations. A burst search finds windows where the flux is high enough, so their durations vary and the time-window setting is only a lower bound. Fixed bins cut the whole stream into abutting windows of exactly that length — the segmentation classic PDA assumes, and the one a dynamic model needs, because exchange is measured in transitions per observation and that requires a known observation time. Read the same file at several bin widths to fit them together for an absolute rate.
